name: Applicative.ext
statement:
theorem Applicative.ext {F} :
    ∀ {A1 : Applicative F} {A2 : Applicative F} [@LawfulApplicative F A1] [@LawfulApplicative F A2],
      (∀ {α : Type u} (x : α), @Pure.pure _ A1.toPure _ x = @Pure.pure _ A2.toPure _ x) →
      (∀ {α β : Type u} (f : F (α → β)) (x : F α),
          @Seq.seq _ A1.toSeq _ _ f (fun _ => x) = @Seq.seq _ A2.toSeq _ _ f (fun _ => x)) →
      A1 = A2
  | { toFunctor := F1, seq := s1, pure := p1, seqLeft := sl1, seqRight := sr1 },
    { toFunctor := F2, seq := s2, pure := p2, seqLeft := sl2, seqRight := sr2 },
    L1, L2, H1, H2 => by
    obtain rfl : @p1 = @p2
proof:
:= by
      funext α x
      apply H1
    obtain rfl : @s1 = @s2 := by
      funext α β f x
      exact H2 f (x Unit.unit)
    obtain ⟨seqLeft_eq1, seqRight_eq1, pure_seq1, -⟩ := L1
    obtain ⟨seqLeft_eq2, seqRight_eq2, pure_seq2, -⟩ := L2
    obtain rfl : F1 = F2 := by
      apply Functor.ext
      intros
      exact (pure_seq1 _ _).symm.trans (pure_seq2 _ _)
    congr <;> funext α β x y
    · exact (seqLeft_eq1 _ (y Unit.unit)).trans (seqLeft_eq2 _ _).symm
    · exact (seqRight_eq1 _ (y Unit.unit)).trans (seqRight_eq2 _ (y Unit.unit)).symm

name: approx_mono'
statement: theorem approx_mono' {i : ℕ} : Fix.approx f i ≤ Fix.approx f (succ i)
proof:
:= by
  induction i with
  | zero => dsimp [approx]; apply @bot_le _ _ _ (f ⊥)
  | succ _ i_ih => intro; apply f.monotone; apply i_ih

name: approx_mono
statement: theorem approx_mono ⦃i j : ℕ⦄ (hij : i ≤ j) : approx f i ≤ approx f j
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero => cases hij; exact le_rfl
  | succ j ih =>
    cases hij; · exact le_rfl
    exact le_trans (ih ‹_›) (approx_mono' f)

name: mem_iff
statement: theorem mem_iff (a : α) (b : β a) : b ∈ Part.fix f a ↔ ∃ i, b ∈ approx f i a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases h₀ : ∃ i : ℕ, (approx f i a).Dom
  · simp only [Part.fix_def f h₀]
    constructor <;> intro hh
    · exact ⟨_, hh⟩
    have h₁ := Nat.find_spec h₀
    rw [dom_iff_mem] at h₁
    obtain ⟨y, h₁⟩ := h₁
    replace h₁ := approx_mono' f _ _ h₁
    suffices y = b by
      subst this
      exact h₁
    obtain ⟨i, hh⟩ := hh
    revert h₁; generalize succ (Nat.find h₀) = j; intro h₁
    wlog case : i ≤ j
    · rcases le_total i j with H | H <;> [skip; symm] <;> apply_assumption <;> assumption
    replace hh := approx_mono f case _ _ hh
    apply Part.mem_unique h₁ hh
  · simp only [fix_def' (⇑f) h₀, not_exists, false_iff, notMem_none]
    simp only [dom_iff_mem, not_exists] at h₀
    intro; apply h₀

name: approx_le_fix
statement: theorem approx_le_fix (i : ℕ) : approx f i ≤ Part.fix f
proof:
:= fun a b hh ↦ by
  rw [mem_iff f]
  exact ⟨_, hh⟩

name: exists_fix_le_approx
statement: theorem exists_fix_le_approx (x : α) : ∃ i, Part.fix f x ≤ approx f i x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! hh : ∃ i b, b ∈ approx f i x
  · rcases hh with ⟨i, b, hb⟩
    exists i
    intro b' h'
    have hb' := approx_le_fix f i _ _ hb
    obtain rfl := Part.mem_unique h' hb'
    exact hb
  · exists 0
    intro b' h'
    simp only [mem_iff f] at h'
    obtain ⟨i, h'⟩ := h'
    cases hh _ _ h'

name: le_f_of_mem_approx
statement: theorem le_f_of_mem_approx {x} : x ∈ approxChain f → x ≤ f x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Membership.mem, forall_exists_index]
  rintro i rfl
  apply approx_mono'

name: approx_mem_approxChain
statement: theorem approx_mem_approxChain {i} : approx f i ∈ approxChain f

name: fix_eq_
statement: theorem fix_eq_ωSup : Part.fix f = ωSup (approxChain f)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x
    obtain ⟨i, hx⟩ := exists_fix_le_approx f x
    trans approx f i.succ x
    · trans
      · apply hx
      · apply approx_mono' f
    apply le_ωSup_of_le i.succ
    dsimp [approx]
    rfl
  · apply ωSup_le _ _ _
    simp only [Fix.approxChain]
    intro y x
    apply approx_le_fix f

name: fix_le
statement: theorem fix_le {X : (a : _) → Part <| β a} (hX : f X ≤ X) : Part.fix f ≤ X
proof:
:= by
  rw [fix_eq_ωSup f]
  apply ωSup_le _ _ _
  simp only [Fix.approxChain]
  intro i
  induction i with
  | zero => apply bot_le
  | succ _ i_ih =>
    trans f X
    · apply f.monotone i_ih
    · apply hX

name: fix_eq_
statement:
theorem fix_eq_ωSup_of_ωScottContinuous (hc : ωScottContinuous g) : Part.fix g =
    ωSup (approxChain (⟨g,hc.monotone⟩ : ((a : _) → Part <| β a) →o (a : _) → Part <| β a))

name: fix_eq_of_
statement:
theorem fix_eq_of_ωScottContinuous (hc : ωScottContinuous g) :
    Part.fix g = g (Part.fix g)
proof:
:= by
  rw [fix_eq_ωSup_of_ωScottContinuous hc, hc.map_ωSup]
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply ωSup_le_ωSup_of_le _
    intro i
    exists i
    apply le_f_of_mem_approx _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
  · apply ωSup_le_ωSup_of_le _
    intro i
    exists i.succ

    f <$> a <*> b = flip f <$> b <*> a
proof:
:=
  calc
    f <$> a <*> b = (fun p : α × β => f p.1 p.2) <$> (Prod.mk <$> a <*> b) := by
      simp only [map_seq, map_map, Function.comp_def]
    _ = (fun b a => f a b) <$> b <*> a := by
      rw [@CommApplicative.commutative_prod m h]
      simp [map_seq, map_map]
      rfl

theorem foldl.unop_ofFreeMonoid (f : β → α → β) (xs : FreeMonoid α) (a : β) :

name: foldMap_hom
statement:
theorem foldMap_hom [Monoid α] [Monoid β] (f : α →* β) (g : γ → α) (x : t γ) :
    f (foldMap g x) = foldMap (f ∘ g) x
proof:
:=
  calc
    f (foldMap g x) = f (traverse (Const.mk' ∘ g) x) := rfl
    _ = (mapFold f).app _ (traverse (Const.mk' ∘ g) x) := rfl
    _ = traverse ((mapFold f).app _ ∘ Const.mk' ∘ g) x := naturality (mapFold f) _ _
    _ = foldMap (f ∘ g) x := rfl

name: toList_spec
statement: theorem toList_spec (xs : t α) : toList xs = FreeMonoid.toList (foldMap FreeMonoid.of xs)
proof:
:=
  Eq.symm <|
    calc
      FreeMonoid.toList (foldMap FreeMonoid.of xs) =
          FreeMonoid.toList (foldMap FreeMonoid.of xs).reverse.reverse := by
          simp only [FreeMonoid.reverse_reverse]
      _ = (List.foldr cons [] (foldMap FreeMonoid.of xs).toList.reverse).reverse := by simp
      _ = (ConcreteCategory.hom
          (unop (Foldl.ofFreeMonoid (flip cons) (foldMap FreeMonoid.of xs))) []).reverse := by
            simp [Function.flip_def, List.foldr_reverse, Foldl.ofFreeMonoid, unop_op]
      _ = toList xs := by
            rw [foldMap_hom_free (Foldl.ofFreeMonoid (flip <| @cons α))]
            simp only [toList, foldl, Foldl.get, foldl.ofFreeMonoid_comp_of,
              Function.comp_apply]

name: length_toList

  generalize toList xs = ys
  rw [← Nat.add_zero ys.length]
  generalize 0 = n

proof:
:=
  calc foldlm f x xs
    _ = unop (foldlM.ofFreeMonoid f (FreeMonoid.ofList <| toList xs)) x := by
      simp only [foldlm, toList_spec, foldMap_hom_free (foldlM.ofFreeMonoid f),
        foldlm.ofFreeMonoid_comp_of, foldlM.get, FreeMonoid.ofList_toList]
    _ = List.foldlM f x (toList xs) := by simp [foldlM.ofFreeMonoid, unop_op, flip]

name: foldlm_map

statement:
protected theorem fix_def {x : α} (h' : ∃ i, (Fix.approx f i x).Dom) :
    Part.fix f x = Fix.approx f (Nat.succ (Nat.find h')) x
proof:
:= by
  let p := fun i : ℕ => (Fix.approx f i x).Dom
  have : p (Nat.find h') := Nat.find_spec h'
  generalize hk : Nat.find h' = k
  replace hk : Nat.find h' = k + (@Upto.zero p).val := hk
  rw [hk] at this
  revert hk
  dsimp [Part.fix]; rw [assert_pos h']; revert this
  generalize Upto.zero = z; intro _this hk
  suffices ∀ x' hwf,
    WellFounded.fix hwf (fixAux f) z x' = Fix.approx f (succ k) x'
    from this _ _
  induction k generalizing z with
  | zero =>
    intro x' _
    rw [Fix.approx, WellFounded.fix_eq, fixAux]
    congr
    ext x : 1
    rw [assert_neg]
    · rfl
    · rw [Nat.zero_add] at _this
      simpa only [not_not, Coe]
  | succ n n_ih =>
    intro x' _
    rw [Fix.approx, WellFounded.fix_eq, fixAux]
    congr
    ext : 1
    have hh : ¬(Fix.approx f z.val x).Dom := by
      apply Nat.find_min h'
      lia
    rw [succ_add_eq_add_succ] at _this hk
    rw [assert_pos hh, n_ih (Upto.succ z hh) _this hk]

statement:
theorem exists_iff_exists_of_mono {P : F α → Prop} {q : F β → Prop}

    (h₀ : f ⊚ g = TypeVec.id)
    (h₁ : ∀ u : F α, P u ↔ q (f <$$> u)) :
    (∃ u : F α, P u) ↔ ∃ u : F β, q u
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> rintro ⟨u, h₂⟩
  · refine ⟨f <$$> u, ?_⟩
    apply (h₁ u).mp h₂
  · refine ⟨g <$$> u, ?_⟩

    simp only [MvFunctor.map_map, h₀, LawfulMvFunctor.id_map, h₂]

      ∃ u : F (Subtype_ R),

          (TypeVec.prod.snd ⊚ subtypeVal R) <$$> u = y
proof:
:=
  exists_iff_exists_of_mono _ _ _ (toSubtype'_of_subtype' R) (by
    simp only [map_map, comp_assoc, subtypeVal_toSubtype']
    simp +unfoldPartialApp [comp])

name: LiftP_PredLast_iff
statement:
theorem LiftP_PredLast_iff {β} (P : β → Prop) (x : F (α ::: β)) :
    LiftP' (PredLast' _ P) x ↔ LiftP (PredLast _ P) x
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [LiftP, LiftP']
  apply exists_iff_exists_of_mono F (f _ n α) (g _ n α)
  · ext i ⟨x, _⟩
    cases i <;> rfl
  · intros
    rw [MvFunctor.map_map]
    dsimp +unfoldPartialApp [(· ⊚ ·)]
    suffices (fun i => Subtype.val) = (fun i x => (MvFunctor.f P n α i x).val) by rw [this]
    ext i ⟨x, _⟩
    cases i <;> rfl

proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [LiftR, LiftR']
  apply exists_iff_exists_of_mono F (f' rr _ _) (g' rr _ _)
  · ext i ⟨x, _⟩ : 2
    cases i <;> rfl
  · intros
    simp +unfoldPartialApp only [map_map, TypeVec.comp]
    apply iff_of_eq

      Comp.mk (Equiv.traverse eqv f <$> Equiv.traverse eqv g x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [traverse_def, comp_traverse, Comp.map_mk]
  simp only [map_map, traverse_def, symm_apply_apply]

name: naturality
statement:
protected theorem naturality (f : α → F β) (x : t' α) :
    η (Equiv.traverse eqv f x) = Equiv.traverse eqv (@η _ ∘ f) x

name: isLawfulTraversable
statement: protected theorem isLawfulTraversable : @LawfulTraversable t' (Equiv.traversable eqv)
proof:
:=
  let _inst := Equiv.traversable eqv
  { toLawfulFunctor := Equiv.lawfulFunctor eqv
    id_traverse := Equiv.id_traverse eqv
    comp_traverse := Equiv.comp_traverse eqv
    traverse_eq_map_id := Equiv.traverse_eq_map_id eqv
    naturality := Equiv.naturality eqv }

name: isLawfulTraversable'
statement:
protected theorem isLawfulTraversable' [Traversable t']
    (h₀ : ∀ {α β} (f : α → β), map f = Equiv.map eqv f)
    (h₁ : ∀ {α β} (f : β), mapConst f = (Equiv.map eqv ∘ Function.const α) f)
    (h₂ : ∀ {F : Type u → Type u} [Applicative F],
      ∀ [LawfulApplicative F] {α β} (f : α → F β), traverse f = Equiv.traverse eqv f) :
    LawfulTraversable t' where
  
  
  toLawfulFunctor
proof:
:= Equiv.lawfulFunctor' eqv @h₀ @h₁
  id_traverse _ := by rw [h₂, Equiv.id_traverse]
  comp_traverse _ _ _ := by rw [h₂, Equiv.comp_traverse, h₂]; congr; rw [h₂]
  traverse_eq_map_id _ _ := by rw [h₂, Equiv.traverse_eq_map_id, h₀]
  naturality _ _ _ _ _ := by rw [h₂, Equiv.naturality, h₂]

name: id_tfst
statement:
@[higher_order tfst_id]
theorem id_tfst : ∀ {α β} (x : t α β), tfst (F := Id) pure x = pure x

name: id_tsnd
statement:
@[higher_order tsnd_id]
theorem id_tsnd : ∀ {α β} (x : t α β), tsnd (F := Id) pure x = pure x

name: comp_tfst
statement:
@[higher_order tfst_comp_tfst]
theorem comp_tfst {α₀ α₁ α₂ β} (f : α₀ → F α₁) (f' : α₁ → G α₂) (x : t α₀ β) :
    Comp.mk (tfst f' <$> tfst f x) = tfst (Comp.mk ∘ map f' ∘ f) x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← comp_bitraverse]
  simp only [Function.comp_def, tfst, map_pure, Pure.pure]

name: tfst_tsnd
statement:
@[higher_order tfst_comp_tsnd]
theorem tfst_tsnd {α₀ α₁ β₀ β₁} (f : α₀ → F α₁) (f' : β₀ → G β₁) (x : t α₀ β₀) :
    Comp.mk (tfst f <$> tsnd f' x)
      = bitraverse (Comp.mk ∘ pure ∘ f) (Comp.mk ∘ map pure ∘ f') x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← comp_bitraverse]
  simp only [Function.comp_def, map_pure]

name: tsnd_tfst
statement:
@[higher_order tsnd_comp_tfst]
theorem tsnd_tfst {α₀ α₁ β₀ β₁} (f : α₀ → F α₁) (f' : β₀ → G β₁) (x : t α₀ β₀) :
    Comp.mk (tsnd f' <$> tfst f x)
      = bitraverse (Comp.mk ∘ map pure ∘ f) (Comp.mk ∘ pure ∘ f') x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← comp_bitraverse]
  simp only [Function.comp_def, map_pure]

name: comp_tsnd
statement:
@[higher_order tsnd_comp_tsnd]
theorem comp_tsnd {α β₀ β₁ β₂} (g : β₀ → F β₁) (g' : β₁ → G β₂) (x : t α β₀) :
    Comp.mk (tsnd g' <$> tsnd g x) = tsnd (Comp.mk ∘ map g' ∘ g) x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← comp_bitraverse]
  simp only [Function.comp_def, map_pure]
  rfl

name: tfst_eq_fst_id
statement:
@[higher_order]
theorem tfst_eq_fst_id {α α' β} (f : α → α') (x : t α β) :
    tfst (F := Id) (pure ∘ f) x = pure (fst f x)

name: tsnd_eq_snd_id
statement:
@[higher_order]
theorem tsnd_eq_snd_id {α β β'} (f : β → β') (x : t α β) :
    tsnd (F := Id) (pure ∘ f) x = pure (snd f x)

name: run_pure
statement:
@[simp]
theorem run_pure (empty : ω) (append : ω → ω → ω) (a : α) :
    letI : Monad (WriterT ω M)
proof:
:= monad empty append
    (pure a : WriterT ω M α).run = pure (a, empty) :=
  rfl

name: run_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem run_map (empty : ω) (append : ω → ω → ω) (f : α → β) (cmd : WriterT ω M α) :
    letI : Monad (WriterT ω M)
proof:
:= monad empty append
    (f <$> cmd).run = (fun (a, w) ↦ (f a, w)) <$> cmd.run :=
  rfl

name: run_bind
statement:
@[simp]
theorem run_bind (empty : ω) (append : ω → ω → ω)
    (cmd : WriterT ω M α) (f : α → WriterT ω M β) :
    letI : Monad (WriterT ω M)
proof:
:= monad empty append
    (cmd >>= f).run = cmd.run >>= fun (a, w₁) ↦
      (fun (b, w₂) ↦ (b, append w₁ w₂)) <$> (f a).run :=
  rfl

name: run_liftM
statement:
@[simp]
theorem run_liftM (empty : ω) (cmd : M α) :
    letI : MonadLift M (WriterT ω M)
proof:
:= WriterT.liftTell empty
    (cmd : WriterT ω M α).run = (fun a ↦ (a, empty)) <$> cmd :=
  rfl

name: run_tell
statement:
@[simp]
theorem run_tell (w : ω) :
    WriterT.run (MonadWriter.tell w : WriterT ω M PUnit) = pure (⟨⟩, w)

name: run_listen
statement:
@[simp]
theorem run_listen (cmd : WriterT ω M α) :
    WriterT.run (MonadWriter.listen cmd) = (fun (a, w) ↦ ((a, w), w)) <$> cmd.run

name: run_pass
statement:
@[simp]
theorem run_pass (cmd : WriterT ω M (α × (ω → ω))) :
    WriterT.run (MonadWriter.pass cmd) = (fun ((a, f), w) ↦ (a, f w)) <$> cmd.run

name: run_throw
statement:
@[simp]
theorem run_throw {M} {ε : Type*} [MonadExceptOf ε M] (e : ε) :
    (throw e : WriterT ω M α).run = throw e

name: run_tryCatch
statement:
@[simp]
theorem run_tryCatch {M} {ε : Type*} [MonadExceptOf ε M]
    (cmd : WriterT ω M α) (c : ε → WriterT ω M α) :
    (tryCatch cmd c : WriterT ω M α).run = tryCatch cmd.run fun e ↦ (c e).run

name: map_eq_bind_pure_comp
statement:
@[monad_norm]
theorem map_eq_bind_pure_comp (m : Type u → Type v) [Monad m] [LawfulMonad m]
    (f : α → β) (x : m α) : f <$> x = x >>= pure ∘ f

name: run_contT_map_contT
statement: theorem run_contT_map_contT (f : m r → m r) (x : ContT r m α) : run (map f x) = f ∘ run x

name: run_withContT
statement:
theorem run_withContT (f : (β → m r) → α → m r) (x : ContT r m α) :
    run (withContT f x) = run x ∘ f

name: ext
statement:
@[ext]
protected theorem ext {x y : ContT r m α} (h : ∀ f, x.run f = y.run f) : x = y
proof:
:= by
  unfold ContT; ext; apply h

name: run_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem run_mk (f : (α → m r) → m r) (k : α → m r) : (.mk f : ContT r m α).run k = f k

name: run_pure
statement:
@[simp]
theorem run_pure (a : α) (k : α → m r) : (pure a : ContT r m α).run k = k a

name: run_bind
statement:
@[simp]
theorem run_bind (x : ContT r m α) (f : α → ContT r m β) (k : β → m r) :
    (x >>= f).run k = x.run fun x => (f x).run k

name: run_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem run_map (f : α → β) (x : ContT r m α) (k : β → m r) :
    (f <$> x).run k = x.run (k ∘ f)

name: run_seq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem run_seq (f : ContT r m (α → β)) (x : ContT r m α) (k : β → m r) :
    (f <*> x).run k = f.run fun f => x.run (k ∘ f)

name: run_seqLeft
statement:
@[simp]
theorem run_seqLeft (x : ContT r m α) (y : ContT r m β) (k : α → m r) :
    (x <* y).run k = x.run fun x => y.run fun _ => k x

name: run_seqRight
statement:
@[simp]
theorem run_seqRight (x : ContT r m α) (y : ContT r m β) (k : β → m r) :
    (x *> y).run k = x.run fun _ => y.run k

name: run_monadLift
statement:
@[simp]
theorem run_monadLift [Monad m] {α} (x : m α) (k : α → m r) :
    (monadLift x : ContT r m α).run k = x >>= k

name: monadLift_bind
statement:
theorem monadLift_bind [Monad m] [LawfulMonad m] {α β} (x : m α) (f : α → m β) :
    (monadLift (x >>= f) : ContT r m β) = monadLift x >>= monadLift ∘ f
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp only [bind_assoc, run_bind, run_monadLift, Function.comp_apply]

name: run_callCC
statement:
@[simp]
theorem run_callCC (f : Label α (ContT r m) β → ContT r m α) (k : α → m r) :
    (callCC f).run k = (f ⟨fun x => .mk fun _ => k x⟩).run k

name: run_throw
statement:
@[simp]
theorem run_throw {ε} [MonadExceptOf ε m]
    (e : ε) (f : α → m r) :
    (throw e : ContT r m α).run f = throw e

name: run_tryCatch
statement:
@[simp]
theorem run_tryCatch {ε} [MonadExceptOf ε m]
    (act : ContT r m α) (h : ε → ContT r m α) (f : α → m r) :
    (tryCatch act h : ContT r m α).run f = tryCatch (act.run f) fun e => (h e).run f

name: ExceptT.goto_mkLabel
statement:
theorem ExceptT.goto_mkLabel {α β ε : Type _} (x : Label (Except.{u, u} ε α) m β) (i : α) :
    goto (ExceptT.mkLabel x) i = ExceptT.mk (Except.ok <$> goto x (Except.ok i))

name: OptionT.goto_mkLabel
statement:
theorem OptionT.goto_mkLabel {α β : Type _} (x : Label (Option.{u} α) m β) (i : α) :
    goto (OptionT.mkLabel x) i = OptionT.mk (goto x (some i) >>= fun a => pure (some a))

name: run_callCC
statement:

lemma run_callCC [MonadCont m] {α β : Type _} (f : Label α (OptionT m) β → OptionT m α) :
    (OptionT.callCC f).run = (callCC fun x => OptionT.run <| f (OptionT.mkLabel x))

name: WriterT.goto_mkLabel
statement:
theorem WriterT.goto_mkLabel {α β ω : Type _} [EmptyCollection ω] (x : Label (α × ω) m β) (i : α) :
    goto (WriterT.mkLabel x) i = monadLift (goto x (i, ∅))

name: WriterT.goto_mkLabel'
statement:
theorem WriterT.goto_mkLabel' {α β ω : Type _} [Monoid ω] (x : Label (α × ω) m β) (i : α) :
    goto (WriterT.mkLabel' x) i = monadLift (goto x (i, 1))

name: StateT.goto_mkLabel
statement:
theorem StateT.goto_mkLabel {α β σ : Type u} (x : Label (α × σ) m (β × σ)) (i : α) :
    goto (StateT.mkLabel x) i = StateT.mk (fun s => goto x (i, s))

name: ReaderT.goto_mkLabel
statement:
theorem ReaderT.goto_mkLabel {α ρ β} (x : Label α m β) (i : α) :
    goto (ReaderT.mkLabel ρ x) i = monadLift (goto x i)
